title: What makes an AI an agent
hook: What makes an AI an agent?

beats.say: A chatbot answers you. An agent actually does the work. The difference is one loop.
First it thinks. What's the next step toward the goal?
Then it acts, with a real tool. Search the web, run code, open a file.
Then it checks what happened, and loops again until the job is done.
That's how coding agents like Claude Code work. Read the code, edit, run the tests, repeat.
The model is the brain. The loop is what turns it into a worker.

caption: What turns a chatbot into an agent? A loop. The model thinks about the next step, acts with a real tool (search, code, files), checks the result, and repeats until the goal is done. Coding agents like Claude Code run exactly this loop: read, edit, test, repeat.
